title: SSRF egress denylist for internal/private targets
description:
A networked MCP server fetches any URL a caller supplies from inside its own network -- no egress guard lets a caller pivot into docker service names, tailnet IPs, or cloud metadata. Needs a denylist on the RESOLVED IP (guard DNS-rebind), on redirects, across every tier, with a settings allowlist escape hatch. Revisit before any multi-user or shared-URL exposure.
